description: Everything happening at a stop in one call: the stop's details, its real-time arrivals, and full detail for every service alert on the stop or on any arrival in the window. Returns what onebusaway_get_stop, onebusaway_get_arrivals, and one onebusaway_get_alert call per alert would, from a single upstream request — arrivals in the onebusaway_get_arrivals shape, alerts in the onebusaway_get_alert shape. The stop omits its served-route list; use onebusaway_get_stop for routeIds. Stop IDs use agency-prefixed format: {agencyId}_{localId} (e.g. "1_75403").

minutesAfter.description: Include arrivals expected within the next N minutes — an integer from 0 to 240. Defaults to 35. For a longer horizon, use onebusaway_get_schedule_for_stop.

minutesBefore.description: Include arrivals that departed up to this many minutes ago — an integer from 0 to 60. Defaults to 5.

stopId.description: Agency-prefixed stop ID (e.g. "1_75403" for Metro Transit stop 75403). Use onebusaway_find_stops or onebusaway_search_stops to discover IDs.

name: onebusaway_get_stop_context

alerts.description: Service alerts on this stop or on any arrival in the window, each listed once — including alerts whose affected arrivals fall outside the window.

items.description: One service alert, in full detail.

activeWindows.description: Time windows when this alert is active.

items.description: A time window during which this alert is active.

from.description: Start of active window as Unix milliseconds, if known.

to.description: End of active window as Unix milliseconds, if known.

affects.description: Stops, routes, trips, or agencies affected by this alert.

items.description: An entity affected by this alert.

agencyId.description: Affected agency ID, if scoped to an agency.

routeId.description: Affected route ID, if scoped to a route.

stopId.description: Affected stop ID, if scoped to a stop.

tripId.description: Affected trip ID, if scoped to a trip.

consequenceMessage.description: Human-readable consequence description (e.g. "Detour in effect"), or null.

diversionStopIds.description: Stop IDs on the diversion path, when condition is "detour".

description.description: Longer description of the alert, or null.

reason.description: Reason code from TPEG: equipmentReason, environmentReason, personnelReason, miscellaneousReason, securityAlert. Null when not provided.

severity.description: Severity level as reported by the agency, or null.

summary.description: Short summary of the service alert.

timezone.description: Validated IANA timezone shared by every affected scope, or UTC when unresolved, invalid, absent, or conflicting.

url.description: URL for more information about this alert, or null.

arrivals.description: Arrivals and departures at this stop within the requested time window.

items.description: A single arrival or departure at this stop.

predicted.description: True if GPS-tracked real-time data is available; false if schedule-only.

predictedArrivalTime.description: Predicted arrival time as Unix milliseconds. Null when predicted=false.

routeId.description: Route ID for follow-up route calls.

scheduleDeviation.description: Seconds late (positive) or early (negative). Only meaningful when predicted=true.

scheduledArrivalTime.description: Scheduled arrival time as Unix milliseconds.

situationIds.description: IDs of active service alerts affecting this arrival.

stopsAway.description: Number of stops until this stop, or null if unknown.

tripId.description: Trip ID for follow-up onebusaway_get_trip calls.

vehicleId.description: Vehicle ID if known, or null.

vehiclePosition.description: Current vehicle position if available, or null.

currentTime.description: Server time as Unix milliseconds, for computing countdown timers.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `stop_not_found`: Stop ID does not exist on this instance. `rate_limited`: No upstream request slot opened within the queue wait cap, or OneBusAway returned a rate limit response. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: What the response is missing and where to get it — no arrivals in the window, stop details absent, or referenced alerts absent.

code.description: The stop code printed on the sign.

direction.description: Compass direction of travel at this stop (e.g. "NW").

stop.description: The queried stop, without its served-route list (use onebusaway_get_stop for routeIds). Null when the upstream response omitted the stop.

timezone.description: Validated timezone of the queried stop agency, or UTC when unavailable or invalid.

windowMinutes.description: Time window used for the arrivals query.

title: Get Stop Context
